Evaluate how well visuals complement the message and connect with the intended audience.

Graphic design, image editing, and video production are not required. Required Skills Experience

Experience with B2B, technology, or professional services content is preferred.

Our Expectation: We are looking for someone who goes beyond grammar correction and can critically evaluate how effectively both written and visual content communicate the intended message to the audience.

Execute quality assurance audit processes and sampling methods within established frameworks, ensuring compliance with team quality standards. Create, develop, and maintain standard operating procedures, documentation, and quality resources, incorporating relevant sources of information. Identify roadblocks and project-level risks; drive resolution through available channels or escalate promptly to appropriate owners. Apply project management best practices to make the team and process area more efficient within defined procedures and timelines. Communicate project status clearly and concisely; provide updates to peers, managers, and partners; trusted to present quality performance and project updates to leaders up to L7. Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with peers and partners within a team environment. Experience creating and maintaining process documentation, including SOPs and quality procedures. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors or higher degree in a relevant field (Program Management, Program Graphic Design, Visual Design, Advertising, Digital Media, Computer Science) or equivalent proven experience. Experience in marketing, campaign management, or digital publishing environments. Familiarity with quality management methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean, or similar). Experience in the entertainment or streaming industry. Background in data analytics and quality reporting; experience building or contributing to quality dashboards. Familiarity with digital advertising platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms). Track record of creating process improvements with measurable impact at the team level. Experience training or onboarding new team members and facilitating knowledge-sharing activities. TekWissen Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title : Content Editor (Copy Editing Visual Review)
Company Name : NewAgeSys IT, (a division of NewAgeSys)
Location : Carnival Infopark, Phase 2 , Kakkanad, Ernakulam
Job Type : Onsite
Shift Timing : 11 AM - 8 PM About the company 
NewAgeSysIT , a division of NewAgeSys, Inc. established in 1994, based at New Jersey, specializes in mobile app development and consulting, helping clients maximize the reach and effectiveness of their business by leveraging the latest technology. Being a full service mobile and web development firm, NewAgeSMB focuses on servicing clients across North America, UK, Europe, Middle East, Singapore and Australia. We accomplish this by creating a long-term relationship with our clients, from brainstorming the initial idea, strategizing the project plan, building and deploying cost effective solutions with a solid foundation of support and maintenance. Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Content Editor to review and refine our business, technical, and marketing content. The primary objective is to improve clarity, readability, tone, and messaging while ensuring the content effectively communicates with its intended audience. The role also includes evaluating supporting visuals for relevance and communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities 
Content Editing Proofreading
Proofread content for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and consistency.
Refine language, sentence structure, and readability while preserving the original meaning.
Improve content flow, messaging, and tone to better engage the target audience.
Identify unclear, repetitive, or ineffective content and suggest improvements.
Ensure consistency with brand voice and professional communication standards.
Content Types Covered
Website pages, landing pages, and blog articles
Newsletters and client announcement emails
Case studies, white papers, and industry reports
Marketing collateral and other business communications Visual Content Review 
Assess the relevance and effectiveness of images, graphics, illustrations, and videos accompanying the content.
Evaluate how well visuals complement the message and connect with the intended audience.
Recommend improvements to visual presentation, including color schemes, background, tone, or image selection where appropriate.
Suggest alternative visual concepts when existing visuals do not effectively support the content.
Graphic design, image editing, and video production are not required. Required Skills Experience 
Proven experience in professional copy editing, proofreading, or content editing.
Ability to refine content for clarity, engagement, and audience relevance.
Experience with B2B, technology, or professional services content is preferred.
Good editorial judgment and a basic understanding of visual communication. Role Expectations 
The candidate should deliver polished, publication-ready content with clear editorial suggestions and actionable feedback on supporting visuals, within mutually agreed timelines. Our Expectation: We are looking for someone who goes beyond grammar correction and can critically evaluate how effectively both written and visual content communicate the intended message to the audience.

Develop creative ideas for Reels, Stories, carousels and posts. Maintain a consistent balance of entertaining, educational, inspirational and sales-oriented content. 2. Reel Scripting & Content Creation Write strong hooks and engaging Reel scripts with clear storytelling. Prepare voiceovers, on-screen text, captions, CTAs and editing instructions. Identify suitable footage from our existing travel videos and photographs. Coordinate with our freelance video editor to ensure timely delivery. Suggest new ways to use existing footage to create multiple pieces of content. 3. Instagram & Facebook Management Schedule and publish content consistently. Manage daily Instagram Stories and maintain an active social media presence. Write platform-appropriate captions and use relevant keywords and hashtags. Respond to relevant comments and identify opportunities to engage with our audience. Keep the profiles organised, updated and aligned with our brand identity. 4. Community & Brand Building Develop content ideas that encourage shares, saves, comments and traveller mentions. Coordinate with our team to collect genuine traveller photos, videos, testimonials and reviews. Create content from real traveller experiences. Develop ideas for collaborations, user-generated content and community engagement. 5. Performance Analysis Track reach, views, watch time, shares, saves, profile visits and follower growth. Identify successful content formats and recommend improvements. Prepare a simple weekly performance report. Focus on organic growth, brand awareness, audience trust and travel enquiries. Requirements Good understanding of Instagram and Facebook content formats. Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills. Good written communication skills. Ability to write engaging Reel scripts and captions. Familiarity with Canva and social media scheduling tools. Ability to coordinate with a freelance video editor. Organised, self-driven and capable of managing work independently. A portfolio of previous social media work is preferred. What This Role Is Not This is not just a posting or account-handling job. You must actively generate ideas, write scripts, plan content and manage execution. Paid advertising and video editing are not the primary responsibilities of this position. Success in This Role The right candidate will help YouthCamping maintain consistent, high-quality social media content, grow its organic audience, strengthen traveller trust and generate more relevant enquiries. To apply: Share your resume and portfolio, including examples of social media accounts, Reels or content calendars you have worked on. Role & responsibilities

Strong freshers with a relevant portfolio can also apply. Core skills: Creative thinking, Reel scripting, storytelling, caption writing and content planning. Platform knowledge: Good understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, carousels and Facebook content. Execution: Ability to independently manage a content calendar and coordinate with a freelance video editor. Analytical skills: Ability to track content performance and suggest improvements based on data. Tools: Familiarity with Trello, Google Drive and Canva. Preferred background: Experience working with travel, lifestyle, adventure or consumer brands. Personal qualities: Proactive, organised, self-driven, detail-oriented and comfortable working independently. Portfolio: Must be able to demonstrate previous content work, Reel scripts or social media accounts managed. Key expectation: Someone who can take ownership of YouthCamping's social media from idea generation to publishing, with minimal daily supervision. 

 Perks and benefits 
 Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

title: Junior AI Full Stack Developer (Freshers | 0-6 Months Experience)
description:
Junior AI Full Stack Developer (Freshers | 0-6 Months Experience) Full-time Adyar, Chennai Posted 3 minutes ago As a Junior AI Full Stack Developer at eholler, you will contribute to the development of AI-powered web applications, intelligent automation systems and AI-based software products. You will work across frontend development, backend APIs, database integration, LLM application development and workflow automation. You will also use modern AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed and productivity while maintaining code quality and understanding the solutions you build. This role is suited to candidates who have a strong foundation in software development and want to build a career in AI engineering and full-stack application development. Key Responsibilities Develop responsive web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Build backend services, REST APIs and application logic using Python or Node.js. Integrate large language models (LLMs) using OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API and other relevant AI services. Develop AI-powered applications such as chatbots, research assistants, content generation tools and business intelligence applications. Build and experiment with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search and AI agent workflows. Work with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI and AutoGen. Integrate databases, manage application data and implement CRUD operations using PostgreSQL, Supabase or MongoDB. Explore vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB and Pinecone for AI application development. Develop workflow automations and API integrations using n8n, Make and webhooks. Use AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, troubleshoot issues, refactor code and improve productivity. Experiment with AI application development platforms such as Lovable, Emergent and Replit to prototype and validate ideas. Test applications, debug issues, improve reliability and maintain clear technical documentation. Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Participate in technical discussions, code reviews and project planning. Learn and apply secure coding practices, application deployment and performance optimisation. Required Technical Skills Candidates are not expected to master every technology in this stack. However, they should have strong fundamentals and practical knowledge of the core technologies. 1. Frontend Development Strong understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Basic to working knowledge of TypeScript. Understanding of React fundamentals. Familiarity with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Exposure to Streamlit or Gradio for building AI application interfaces is an advantage. 2. Backend Development and APIs Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, functions, modules and error handling. Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP requests and API integration. Familiarity with FastAPI, Flask or Node.js/Express. Understanding of environment variables and secure API key management. 3. AI and LLM Development Basic understanding of generative AI, large language models and prompt engineering. Familiarity with integrating at least one LLM API is preferred. Understanding of structured outputs, conversation history and tool calling is an advantage. Interest in RAG, embeddings, semantic search and AI agents. Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI or AutoGen is a plus. 4. Database Technologies Basic understanding of SQL and database design. Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Supabase or MongoDB. Understanding of database integration and CRUD operations. Exposure to vector databases such as FAISS, ChromaDB or Pinecone is an advantage. 5. AI-Assisted Coding and Development Tools Candidates should be willing to use modern AI development tools responsibly, including: Cursor GitHub Copilot Claude Lovable Emergent Replit OpenClaw, where relevant to the project The ability to understand, validate, debug and improve AI-generated code is essential. Merely knowing how to generate code using AI tools is not sufficient. 6. Workflow Automation Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks and application integrations. Familiarity with n8n or Make is an advantage. Interest in connecting AI models, databases and business applications through automated workflows. 7. Development Fundamentals Familiarity with Git and GitHub. Basic knowledge of debugging, testing and code organisation. Willingness to learn deployment, hosting and application monitoring. Ability to explain technical decisions and communicate project progress clearly. Eligibility Criteria We welcome applications from: Fresh graduates in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related disciplines. Candidates from other educational backgrounds with demonstrable programming skills and relevant projects. Freshers with strong technical knowledge of full-stack or AI application development. Candidates with 0-6 months of professional experience. Candidates who have completed relevant software development, AI or full-stack development internships. Self-taught developers who can demonstrate their capabilities through working applications or GitHub projects. Prior industry experience is not mandatory. Strong fundamentals, practical implementation skills and the ability to learn are more important than the number of tools listed on a resume. What We Expect From You Strong interest in AI engineering, software development and application building. Ability to write, understand and debug code. Willingness to learn new frameworks and technologies as project requirements evolve. Ability to build small applications independently and contribute to larger projects with guidance. A practical approach to solving technical problems. Responsibility for assigned tasks, deadlines and code quality. Openness to feedback, code reviews and continuous learning. Clear communication and the ability to explain your work. What You Will Work On At eholler, you may contribute to projects involving: AI-powered web applications and SaaS products. LLM-based assistants and research tools. RAG applications and knowledge retrieval systems. AI agents and multi-step automation workflows. Business process automation using n8n and APIs. Full-stack applications integrating frontend interfaces, backend services, databases and AI models. Rapid prototyping and product development using AI-assisted coding platforms. Your responsibilities will grow as you demonstrate technical ability and become comfortable working with the development team. What eholler Offers An opportunity to work on practical AI and full-stack development projects. Exposure to modern AI technologies, LLM APIs and agent-based applications. Hands-on experience with frontend, backend, databases and automation. Guidance from the development team and opportunities to learn through code reviews. A collaborative environment that encourages experimentation and practical problem-solving. Opportunities to take ownership of features and contribute to product development. Career growth based on technical development, contribution and performance. Job Features Job Category AI Development, Web Development

Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership. Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments. Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution. Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure. Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality. 
 Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation). Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data. Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning). Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports. Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans. Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting. Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs). APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps. Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone. title: Senior PAS Delivery Architect
description:
Senior PAS Delivery Architect Scitara Service Delivery Product Application Services 
 
 Senior PAS Delivery Architect 
 Product Application Services Scitara DLX Implementation Validation Location Pune / Mumbai, India Department Department Service Delivery Experience Experience 10+ years lab informatics architecture connectivity Education Education Bachelors or Masters (CS / Life Sciences / related) The role in one sentence You lead the configuration, implementation and validation of the Scitara DLX platform for global pharma and life-sciences customers owning delivery quality, guiding customers to scalable, compliant solutions , and building a high-performing PAS team . 
 
 Why Scitara 
 A fast-growing, globally recognized platform revolutionizing lab connectivity in pharma and life sciences. Scitara DLX connects laboratory instruments, applications, data and people. Work at the forefront of AI-driven lab automation and advanced integration the move toward smart labs . Collaborate with industry-leading experts and contribute directly to scientific innovation at global scale. 
 
 About the Role 
 Customer-facing leadership role in Scitaras Services organization. Leads configuration, implementation and validation of DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Works across Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture and Customer Success to deliver high-impact outcomes. Requires technical architecture and instrument-connectivity expertise , consulting skills and a strong sense of ownership . 
 
 One role, three strengths 
 
 Delivery Leader 
 Owns implementation and validation outcomes for DLX customers 
 
 Technical Architect 
 Designs instrument and system connectivity with GxP depth 
 
 Team Builder 
 Mentors the PAS team and raises its capability and standards 
 
 Delivery ownership 
 You lead PAS delivery across the DLX lifecycle 01 Discover 02 Design Input 03 Configure 04 Implement 05 Validate 06 Hand Over Reuse 
 
 This role IS 
 Hands-on delivery leadership of DLX implementations. Customer-facing discovery calls, demos and value-based recommendations. Leading and mentoring PAS team members in an Agile delivery model. Balancing technical depth with business alignment . 
 
 This role is NOT 
 A functional LIMS/ELN configuration or ticket-resolution role. People management without technical depth you stay close to the solution. A pure pre-sales or demo role you stay accountable through validation. Order-taking you translate needs into sound technical requirements. A CSV-only role although you need a good understanding of CSV/CSA . 
 
 What you will do 
 Core responsibilities 
 
 1 Implementation Validation Delivery 
 Lead the implementation and validation of Scitara DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Own the technical architecture for instrument and system connectivity scalable, compliant and robust . Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements , working closely with Software Application Specialists. Ensure delivery meets GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ and GAMP 5 expectations. 
 
 2 Customer Engagement Consulting 
 Participate in customer calls drive discovery , influence solution design and give value-oriented technical recommendations . Deliver effective product demonstrations and communicate DLXs value proposition clearly. Engage stakeholders through consultative, value-based storytelling including at executive level. 
 
 3 Team Leadership Capability 
 Mentor and guide PAS team members; build a culture of excellence, innovation and continuous learning. Work in or lead Agile delivery teams ; align team execution with company objectives. Drive performance and operational efficiency across PAS engagements. Champion knowledge sharing, best practices and internal training within PAS. 
 
 4 Cross-Functional Alignment Assets 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects and Software Engineers for smooth handovers and cohesive outcomes. Align delivery strategies with Scitaras business objectives and product roadmap . Contribute to technical documentation, internal playbooks and customer-facing collateral . 
 
 Extended scope (good to have) 
 Not mandatory; candidates who show these will be preferred 
 
 Value Discovery Consulting 
 Lead discovery workshops; quantify value and define success criteria. Challenge unnecessary customization ; steer customers toward standard, scalable approaches. 
 
 Scalable, Reusable Patterns 
 Establish First-of-Kind integration patterns and Adaptive Workflows . Drive configuration-led reuse across equivalent instruments, labs and sites. 
 
 Forward-Deployed Bridging 
 Surface cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies before they block delivery. Provide technical continuity from discovery through deployment and Hypercare. 
 
 Proof of Value Production Readiness 
 Support or lead PoV and pilot engagements. Prove scalability, operability and reuse not only functionality. 
 
 AI-Enabled Lab Transformation 
 Translate AI agents and automation into practical RD and QC use cases. Show how standardized, contextualized data enables AI/ML. 
 
 Commercial Input 
 Review SOWs, estimates and assumptions so commitments are technically achievable. Feed delivery experience back into product and methodology . 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 DLX implementations are delivered on time, validated and audit-ready . Customers see you as a trusted technical advisor , not just a delivery resource. Solutions are scalable and supportable not one-off configurations. The PAS team grows more capable through your mentoring, playbooks and training. 
 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the move toward smart labs with AI-driven automation and advanced integration. Work with industry-leading experts and some of the brightest minds in science. Enable breakthroughs that accelerate RD and improve data-driven decisions globally. A dynamic culture of continuous learning, creativity and growth . 
 
 What you bring 
 Must have first, then good to have Must have 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences lab informatics, with strong technical architecture skills designing how instruments, LIMS/ELN/LES/CDS and enterprise systems connect. Technical configuration of LIMS/ELN for instrument connectivity interfaces, instrument data capture, parsing and mapping, and data flows between instruments and systems. Enterprise integration : REST APIs, JSON/XML, file-based interfaces, data mapping, error handling and retry. Customer-facing consultative experience leading discovery, translating needs into technical requirements, and influencing stakeholders through persuasive, value-based storytelling . Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences or a related field. Strong pharma and life-sciences domain knowledge, including QC and RD laboratory processes and regulatory expectations. Working knowledge of lab instruments and their software like Empower, Chromeleon, SoftMax Pro, Tecan Magellan, UNICORN/KTA, LabX (and controlled instruments such as pH meters and balances). Well versed in 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+, GAMP 5 and GxP , with a good understanding of CSV (validation planning, risk-based testing, traceability). This is not a CSV-only role . Experience working in or leading Agile teams . Able to balance technical depth with business alignment contributing to both strategic planning and hands-on delivery. Good to have Technical Scripting in JavaScript and/or Python . Data platforms (databases, data lakes) and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS . Data standards such as ASM, AnIML and SiLA . Event-driven integration , monitoring tools, deployment frameworks or infrastructure automation. CSA (Computer Software Assurance) alongside CSV. Good to have AI Practical familiarity with Generative AI / LLMs, agentic AI, prompt and context engineering, RAG and AI-assisted development. Evidence of self-directed AI learning courses, prototypes or automations you built yourself. Good to have Background Prior role as applications scientist, lab informatics specialist, lab manager or scientist . Experience across multiple systems, vendors, labs or sites . Experience leading Proof-of-Value or pilot engagements. Please note: functional LIMS/ELN/LES implementation or business configuration experience on its own does not meet this bar . We need technical architecture, instrument-connectivity depth and customer consulting experience. 
 
 How you work 
 Core attributes, plus valued extras 
 
 Customer-centric mindset 
 Consultative; identifies pain points and delivers tailored solutions. 
 
 Strategic alignment 
 Understands Scitaras vision and product roadmap, and delivers toward it. 
 
 Domain-aware execution 
 Considers the broader needs of the pharma and life-sciences sector. 
 
 Storytelling communication 
 Explains complex concepts with clarity and conviction in demos and executive discussions. 
 
 Ownership 
 Stays accountable for delivery outcomes and drives issues to closure. 
 
 Team leadership 
 Mentors, sets standards and builds a culture of continuous learning. 
 
 Constructive challenge Good to have 
 Good to have Professionally pushes back when evidence or customer outcomes require it. 
 
 Influence without authority Good to have 
 Good to have Mobilizes teams and vendors across organizational boundaries. 
 
 Curiosity, especially AI Good to have 
 Good to have Actively experiments with AI and modern software practices. 
 
 Commercial awareness Good to have 
 Good to have Knows how technical choices affect effort, risk and total cost of ownership.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer, AI-Enabled Services (GCP)Role Summary We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and ship production-ready AI-enabled services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Our agents and workflows are assembled in a low-code agent builder and n8n. This role focuses on the high-code layer underneath: MCP servers, APIs, and application services that give those agents and workflows secure, reliable access to enterprise systems and data.The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with a rigorous approach to quality and the ability to work directly with partners. You will translate business needs from technical and non-technical stakeholders into well-designed, well-tested services, and you will hold a high bar for what "production-ready" means. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain high-code services on GCP, including MCP servers, APIs, and supporting application services, using Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and related capabilities. Build integrations with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and event streams that low-code agents and n8n workflows can use reliably. Own quality for the products you build: define test strategies, write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and establish release-readiness criteria. Validate the behavior of AI-enabled workflows, including tool invocation, error handling, edge cases, and regressions, and help define evaluation approaches for non-deterministic outputs. Design, develop, and manage relational database schemas, queries, migrations, and performance tuning in support of application and workflow needs. Meet with partners, both technical and non-technical, to gather requirements, clarify goals, and walk through designs. Translate their needs into clear technical specifications, and explain trade-offs, risks, and status in language each audience understands. Collaborate with architects, product managers, and domain experts to shape scalable solutions and set expectations on scope, timelines, and quality. Help define patterns and standards for service design, observability, testing, security, and operational support across our low-code and high-code environments. Implement strong engineering practices, including CI/CD, code reviews, monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure-as-code. Optimize solutions for performance, resilience, cost, and maintainability. Partner with security and platform teams to ensure compliant and secure handling of data, credentials, and enterprise integrations. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven experience as a software engineer building and supporting production-grade applications and services. Strong programming skills in one or more modern languages such as Python, TypeScript, or Java. Hands-on experience building and deploying services on Google Cloud Platform. Demonstrated QA discipline: experience with test automation, test planning, API and integration testing, and release validation for production systems. Strong experience with relational database development and management, including schema design, SQL, indexing, query optimization, and migrations. Experience developing and consuming REST APIs and working with event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Familiarity with containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Excellent communication skills , with a track record of gathering requirements and discussing design with both technical and non-technical partners, and of presenting technical concepts clearly to varied audiences. Ability to work across technical and functional teams in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Experience Experience building or consuming MCP servers or similar tool-integration layers for AI agents. Experience with low-code or workflow automation platforms such as n8n, and an understanding of how to build services that support them. Experience with NoSQL databases, vector stores, and analytical platforms. Exposure to AI-native applications, such as LLM-based workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or tool use, including methods for evaluating and testing them. Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, middleware, and event streaming. Experience designing systems with observability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop controls. Understanding of AI application risks, including hallucination, security boundaries, governance, and responsible AI controls. Experience in enterprise environments where reliability, compliance, and scalability are critical. What Success Looks Like The services you ship are production-ready, thoroughly tested, and dependable, not experimental. Partners trust you: they feel heard during requirements discussions and understand the design decisions that follow. Low-code agents and n8n workflows can connect to enterprise systems through your MCP servers and services without surprises. You raise the quality bar for the team by establishing sound testing, release, and operational patterns. You balance speed with discipline, delivering solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. Example Areas of Work MCP servers and APIs that expose enterprise capabilities to low-code agents and n8n workflows Relational data services supporting approvals, case management, and workflow state Integrations between AI services and enterprise systems such as HR, IT, collaboration, and knowledge platforms Test automation, evaluation harnesses, and release-readiness checks for AI-enabled workflows Requirements and design sessions with business and technical partners

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization. Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment. Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones. Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows. Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews. Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth. Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production). Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up. 
 1. Demand Planning & S&OP Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan. Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering. Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions. Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook. Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework. Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes. Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases. 
 2. Production Planning & Control Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand. Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers. Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders. Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations. Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters. Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput. Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases. 
 3. Material Planning & MRP Existing responsibilities plus: Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan. Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints. Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including: Lead times Lot sizes Safety stocks Reorder levels MOQ Supplier lead times Planning horizons Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts. Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production. Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness. 
 4. Procurement & Supplier Management Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements. Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions. Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness. Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries. Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks. Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required. Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives. Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements. Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components. Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate. 
 5. Inventory Management Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods. Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements. Drive reduction of: Excess inventory Obsolete inventory Slow-moving inventory Uncontrolled WIP Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes. Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity. 
 6. Warehouse & Logistics Existing responsibilities plus: Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations. Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production. Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable. Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials. Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability. Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes. Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site. Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch. 
 Support implementation of traceability systems. Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements. Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions. Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions. Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions. 7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain Existing responsibilities plus: Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems. Establish robust governance for: BOM Material master Routings Lead times Planning parameters Purchase orders Production orders Inventory records Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring. Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation. Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment. Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements. Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live. Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities. Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch. 
 8. Risk Management & Business Continuity Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity. Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions. Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics. Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks. 
 9. Continuous Improvement Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving. Improve: Planning accuracy Inventory turns Supplier OTD Material availability Production plan adherence Lead time OTIF Supply Chain cost Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization. 
 10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs. Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness. Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable. 
 Candidate Profile Education : Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent. Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred. Experience 10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment. Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred. Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization. 
 Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment. Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment. Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up. Technical Competencies Existing competencies plus: S&OP / IBP MPS / MRP Production Planning & Control Material Planning Procurement Inventory Management Warehouse Management Supplier Management Capacity Planning ERP / MRP / PLM systems Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up Project Management Program Management Change Management ERP Deployment & Go-Live Master Data Governance Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews New Product Introduction (NPI) 
 Leadership Competencies Existing competencies plus: Strong analytical and problem-solving capability Ability to manage cross-functional teams Strong stakeholder-management skills Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment Strong execution discipline Data-driven decision making Excellent communication and escalation management Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up. Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth. Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities. Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments. 
 Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

title: Senior PAS Delivery Architect
description:
Senior PAS Delivery Architect Scitara Service Delivery Product Application Services 
 
 Senior PAS Delivery Architect 
 Product Application Services Scitara DLX Implementation Validation Location Pune / Mumbai, India Department Department Service Delivery Experience Experience 10+ years lab informatics architecture connectivity Education Education Bachelors or Masters (CS / Life Sciences / related) The role in one sentence You lead the configuration, implementation and validation of the Scitara DLX platform for global pharma and life-sciences customers owning delivery quality, guiding customers to scalable, compliant solutions , and building a high-performing PAS team . 
 
 Why Scitara 
 A fast-growing, globally recognized platform revolutionizing lab connectivity in pharma and life sciences. Scitara DLX connects laboratory instruments, applications, data and people. Work at the forefront of AI-driven lab automation and advanced integration the move toward smart labs . Collaborate with industry-leading experts and contribute directly to scientific innovation at global scale. 
 
 About the Role 
 Customer-facing leadership role in Scitaras Services organization. Leads configuration, implementation and validation of DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Works across Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture and Customer Success to deliver high-impact outcomes. Requires technical architecture and instrument-connectivity expertise , consulting skills and a strong sense of ownership . 
 
 One role, three strengths 
 
 Delivery Leader 
 Owns implementation and validation outcomes for DLX customers 
 
 Technical Architect 
 Designs instrument and system connectivity with GxP depth 
 
 Team Builder 
 Mentors the PAS team and raises its capability and standards 
 
 Delivery ownership 
 You lead PAS delivery across the DLX lifecycle 01 Discover 02 Design Input 03 Configure 04 Implement 05 Validate 06 Hand Over Reuse 
 
 This role IS 
 Hands-on delivery leadership of DLX implementations. Customer-facing discovery calls, demos and value-based recommendations. Leading and mentoring PAS team members in an Agile delivery model. Balancing technical depth with business alignment . 
 
 This role is NOT 
 A functional LIMS/ELN configuration or ticket-resolution role. People management without technical depth you stay close to the solution. A pure pre-sales or demo role you stay accountable through validation. Order-taking you translate needs into sound technical requirements. A CSV-only role although you need a good understanding of CSV/CSA . 
 
 What you will do 
 Core responsibilities 
 
 1 Implementation Validation Delivery 
 Lead the implementation and validation of Scitara DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Own the technical architecture for instrument and system connectivity scalable, compliant and robust . Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements , working closely with Software Application Specialists. Ensure delivery meets GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ and GAMP 5 expectations. 
 
 2 Customer Engagement Consulting 
 Participate in customer calls drive discovery , influence solution design and give value-oriented technical recommendations . Deliver effective product demonstrations and communicate DLXs value proposition clearly. Engage stakeholders through consultative, value-based storytelling including at executive level. 
 
 3 Team Leadership Capability 
 Mentor and guide PAS team members; build a culture of excellence, innovation and continuous learning. Work in or lead Agile delivery teams ; align team execution with company objectives. Drive performance and operational efficiency across PAS engagements. Champion knowledge sharing, best practices and internal training within PAS. 
 
 4 Cross-Functional Alignment Assets 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects and Software Engineers for smooth handovers and cohesive outcomes. Align delivery strategies with Scitaras business objectives and product roadmap . Contribute to technical documentation, internal playbooks and customer-facing collateral . 
 
 Extended scope (good to have) 
 Not mandatory; candidates who show these will be preferred 
 
 Value Discovery Consulting 
 Lead discovery workshops; quantify value and define success criteria. Challenge unnecessary customization ; steer customers toward standard, scalable approaches. 
 
 Scalable, Reusable Patterns 
 Establish First-of-Kind integration patterns and Adaptive Workflows . Drive configuration-led reuse across equivalent instruments, labs and sites. 
 
 Forward-Deployed Bridging 
 Surface cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies before they block delivery. Provide technical continuity from discovery through deployment and Hypercare. 
 
 Proof of Value Production Readiness 
 Support or lead PoV and pilot engagements. Prove scalability, operability and reuse not only functionality. 
 
 AI-Enabled Lab Transformation 
 Translate AI agents and automation into practical RD and QC use cases. Show how standardized, contextualized data enables AI/ML. 
 
 Commercial Input 
 Review SOWs, estimates and assumptions so commitments are technically achievable. Feed delivery experience back into product and methodology . 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 DLX implementations are delivered on time, validated and audit-ready . Customers see you as a trusted technical advisor , not just a delivery resource. Solutions are scalable and supportable not one-off configurations. The PAS team grows more capable through your mentoring, playbooks and training. 
 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the move toward smart labs with AI-driven automation and advanced integration. Work with industry-leading experts and some of the brightest minds in science. Enable breakthroughs that accelerate RD and improve data-driven decisions globally. A dynamic culture of continuous learning, creativity and growth . 
 
 What you bring 
 Must have first, then good to have Must have 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences lab informatics, with strong technical architecture skills designing how instruments, LIMS/ELN/LES/CDS and enterprise systems connect. Technical configuration of LIMS/ELN for instrument connectivity interfaces, instrument data capture, parsing and mapping, and data flows between instruments and systems. Enterprise integration : REST APIs, JSON/XML, file-based interfaces, data mapping, error handling and retry. Customer-facing consultative experience leading discovery, translating needs into technical requirements, and influencing stakeholders through persuasive, value-based storytelling . Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences or a related field. Strong pharma and life-sciences domain knowledge, including QC and RD laboratory processes and regulatory expectations. Working knowledge of lab instruments and their software like Empower, Chromeleon, SoftMax Pro, Tecan Magellan, UNICORN/KTA, LabX (and controlled instruments such as pH meters and balances). Well versed in 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+, GAMP 5 and GxP , with a good understanding of CSV (validation planning, risk-based testing, traceability). This is not a CSV-only role . Experience working in or leading Agile teams . Able to balance technical depth with business alignment contributing to both strategic planning and hands-on delivery. Good to have Technical Scripting in JavaScript and/or Python . Data platforms (databases, data lakes) and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS . Data standards such as ASM, AnIML and SiLA . Event-driven integration , monitoring tools, deployment frameworks or infrastructure automation. CSA (Computer Software Assurance) alongside CSV. Good to have AI Practical familiarity with Generative AI / LLMs, agentic AI, prompt and context engineering, RAG and AI-assisted development. Evidence of self-directed AI learning courses, prototypes or automations you built yourself. Good to have Background Prior role as applications scientist, lab informatics specialist, lab manager or scientist . Experience across multiple systems, vendors, labs or sites . Experience leading Proof-of-Value or pilot engagements. Please note: functional LIMS/ELN/LES implementation or business configuration experience on its own does not meet this bar . We need technical architecture, instrument-connectivity depth and customer consulting experience. 
 
 How you work 
 Core attributes, plus valued extras 
 
 Customer-centric mindset 
 Consultative; identifies pain points and delivers tailored solutions. 
 
 Strategic alignment 
 Understands Scitaras vision and product roadmap, and delivers toward it. 
 
 Domain-aware execution 
 Considers the broader needs of the pharma and life-sciences sector. 
 
 Storytelling communication 
 Explains complex concepts with clarity and conviction in demos and executive discussions. 
 
 Ownership 
 Stays accountable for delivery outcomes and drives issues to closure. 
 
 Team leadership 
 Mentors, sets standards and builds a culture of continuous learning. 
 
 Constructive challenge Good to have 
 Good to have Professionally pushes back when evidence or customer outcomes require it. 
 
 Influence without authority Good to have 
 Good to have Mobilizes teams and vendors across organizational boundaries. 
 
 Curiosity, especially AI Good to have 
 Good to have Actively experiments with AI and modern software practices. 
 
 Commercial awareness Good to have 
 Good to have Knows how technical choices affect effort, risk and total cost of ownership.

title: Manager / Senior Manager -Supply Chain Management (SCM)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Manager / Senior Manager Supply Chain Management to manage end-to-end supply chain operations for our fertilizer business. The candidate will be responsible for demand planning, procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, logistics, vendor management, and cost optimization. The role requires strong coordination with Production, Quality, Finance, and Commercial teams to ensure smooth plant operations, timely material availability, and efficient product distribution. Key Responsibilities 1. Supply Chain Strategy & Planning Lead demand planning, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP). Prepare monthly rolling forecasts and ensure alignment between production plans and sales requirements. Develop supply chain strategies for raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Optimize inventory levels and ensure uninterrupted supply to manufacturing operations. 2. Procurement & Vendor Management Manage procurement of raw materials such as urea, complex fertilizers, additives, and packaging materials. Identify and develop suppliers, negotiate contracts, and manage vendor relationships. Conduct supplier performance reviews, RFQs, cost negotiations, and vendor assessments. Develop alternate sourcing strategies to minimize supply risks. 3. Production Planning & Coordination Coordinate with production teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials. Prepare material requisitions and prioritize critical procurement requirements. Monitor work-in-progress (WIP), material consumption, yield variations, and product changeovers. Ensure smooth coordination between production and supply chain functions. 4. Warehouse & Inventory Management Manage warehouse operations and inventory across manufacturing plants and distribution locations. Implement FIFO practices, batch traceability, stock audits, and regular cycle counts. Maintain inventory accuracy and coordinate stock reconciliation with Finance. Ensure proper storage conditions to prevent moisture ingress, product contamination, and material damage. 5. Logistics & Distribution Management Manage inbound and outbound logistics, dispatch planning, and transportation operations. Handle third-party logistics (3PL) partners, transport routing, and freight negotiations. Optimize freight costs and ensure timely product deliveries. Monitor shipping documentation, GRNs, delivery challans, and ERP updates. 6. Regulatory Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with Fertilizer Control Order (FCO), fertilizer handling regulations, and applicable safety standards. Maintain MSDS documentation, proper labeling, storage, and emergency handling procedures. Ensure safe transportation and handling of raw materials and finished products. 7. Cost Optimization & Performance Management Drive working capital optimization and reduce inventory holding costs. Monitor inventory turnover, logistics costs, procurement savings, and stock availability. Track KPIs such as OTIF, inventory accuracy, freight cost per ton, and stockout incidents. Prepare MIS reports and present supply chain performance to senior management. 8. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and manage procurement, warehouse, dispatch, and logistics teams. Coordinate with Production, Quality, Finance, and Commercial departments. Establish SOPs, operational processes, and performance standards. Develop team capabilities and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a relevant field. MBA preferred. 8 - 12+ years of experience in Supply Chain Management, with at least 3 - 5 years in a leadership role. Candidates from Fertilizer, Chemical, or Manufacturing industries will be preferred. Strong experience in procurement, demand planning, inventory control, warehouse management, and logistics. Hands-on experience in S&OP, MRP, FIFO, and 3PL management. Knowledge of ERP systems, advanced MS Excel, and data analysis tools. Strong vendor negotiation, supplier development, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of FCO, fertilizer handling regulations, and industrial safety standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership abilities. Willingness to work onsite at Roha / Pune and travel occasionally to vendors and distribution hubs.

Key Skills: Material requirement planning,Logistics,Oracle,Operations planning,Logistics management,Demand planning,Senior management,Warehouse

 The Role: The Permanent Player-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone-wolf architect. This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest. 
 Experience Range: 12 to 15 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience. The 6-Month Trajectory: Months 1-2 (Heavy Architecture): Your focus will be architecting the AWS-to-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team. Months 3-6+ (The Steady State): You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role. You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1-on-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery. Youll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities: Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem. Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep. Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories. Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt. Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise-grade engineers. Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap. Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders. 
 Requirements: 12 to 15 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey). Senior-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus. Deep, practical, hands-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs. Experience integrating complex third-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes. High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one. Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS*, GCP, Azure)

title: Operations Associate
description:
Business Operations & Growth Associate (Founder's Office) Company: POBO Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Sector 116, Noida
 Employment Type: Full-time | In-office
 Working Days: 6 days/week
 Experience: 03 years
 CTC: 3.6–4.8 LPA + Performance-Linked Bonus
 Reports to: COO / Founders About POBO POBO — Power of Being One — is a real-estate startup building a tech-enabled platform around buyer collectives. We bring together individuals with similar property requirements so they can negotiate with the collective power, price advantage and protection traditionally available to institutional buyers. Our proposition: Where Individuals Buy Like Institutions. We are currently building the business from the ground up — across technology, operations, customer acquisition, partnerships and real-estate transactions. About the Role We are looking for a Business Operations & Growth Associate who wants to learn how a startup is actually built from the inside. This is not a narrow operations or desk-only role. You will work closely with POBO’s founders across business operations, growth, marketing, research, data, technology, AI and execution . Some problems will come with a process. Many won’t. We are looking for someone who can take an ambiguous task, figure out what needs to be done and take it from idea research plan execution . What You’ll Work On Business Operations Track business priorities, projects and deliverables. Coordinate across teams, vendors and external partners. Build and maintain trackers, processes and documentation. Follow up on deliverables and help turn plans into execution. Growth & Marketing Support digital, performance, community and offline marketing initiatives. Coordinate content, campaigns, social media and marketing experiments. Track leads, campaigns and customer acquisition initiatives. Help test new channels and growth ideas. Research & Business Development Research real-estate projects, developers, markets, customers, competitors and pricing. Identify potential partnerships and business opportunities. Maintain structured databases and convert research into actionable insights. Data & Insights Work with Excel/Google Sheets, lead data, funnels, trackers and dashboards. Analyse business information and present clear insights to the founders. Help identify gaps, trends and opportunities from business data. Product, Technology & AI Test POBO’s app, CRM and digital workflows. Identify bugs and coordinate with developers. Evaluate tools for calling, WhatsApp, SMS, hosting, CRM and other business requirements. Use AI tools to improve research, productivity, marketing and internal processes. Founder Projects Work directly on high-priority projects with the founders. Take cross-functional assignments from research to implementation. Support vendor coordination, documentation and operational problem-solving. Market Exposure Interact with customers, partners, vendors and local networks when required. Understand the real-estate market through actual execution, not just online research. Who We’re Looking For Education Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Candidates from Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Technology, Architecture or related backgrounds are welcome. Your ability to think and execute matters more to us than your degree. Experience 0–3 years of experience in operations, founder’s office, growth, consulting, business development, project coordination or a startup environment. Strong fresh graduates with relevant internships, projects or demonstrated ownership are encouraged to apply. Skills Strong written and verbal communication. Good research and problem-solving ability. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and presentations. Comfortable using AI tools. Familiarity with CRM, analytics, no-code tools, performance marketing or technology is a bonus. The Kind of Person Who Will Do Well Here You are someone who: Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions for every step. Can figure things out even when there is no existing playbook. Follows through and doesn’t need to be constantly chased. Flags problems early instead of hiding them. Is comfortable handling multiple priorities. Asks good questions and communicates clearly. Enjoys learning new tools and solving unfamiliar problems. Is genuinely curious about startups, technology, consumer behaviour, business and/or real estate. Compensation Fixed CTC: 3.6–4.8 LPA Equivalent to approximately 30,000–40,000 per month , depending on experience, capability and role fit. Plus performance-linked bonuses based on clearly defined individual and business outcomes. As POBO grows, strong performers will have the opportunity to take ownership of larger workstreams, manage projects independently and grow into broader operations / founder’s office responsibilities. Why Join POBO? Work directly with the founders. See how an early-stage company is actually built. Exposure across operations, growth, marketing, product, technology, AI, research and real estate. Work on real business problems instead of repetitive support tasks. Take ownership of projects you can directly point to. Opportunity for significantly greater responsibility as the company grows. We care more about initiative, integrity, curiosity and execution than titles and credentials. Selection Process Application Founder Conversation Short Practical Assignment Final Discussion When applying, please share your CV along with a brief note about one task, project or initiative that you independently took from start to completion.
