title: Full-Stack Software Engineer  India (Remote)
description:
ZeeNovo Health Full-Stack Software Engineer India (Remote) Company: ZeeNovo Corporation (Canada)
 Product: ZeeNovo Health
 Position: Full-Stack Software Engineer
 Location: India — Remote
 Experience: 3–6 years of relevant production software development
 Employment: Full-time, initially 12-month fixed term
 1. About ZeeNovo Health® ZeeNovo Health® is a Canadian healthcare technology platform developing connected software solutions for community pharmacies. Our software supports clinical assessments, appointment booking, medication safety, compounding, quality improvement, documentation, analytics, and pharmacy operations. Our platform includes: ZeeNovo Clinical: Minor ailments, immunizations, medication injections, automated follow-ups, patient documentation and clinical analytics. ZeeNovo Assure: Medication incident reporting, continuous quality improvement, pharmacy assessments, corrective actions and compliance-related workflows. ZeeNovo Magistral: Pharmacy compounding management (Beta). Enterprise & Partner Solutions: Centralized booking, pharmacy group administration, permissions and consolidated analytics. Medication Reviews and POCT: Additional clinical services under development. 
 We are looking for developers capable of contributing to an existing production platform, improving reliability, and developing new features with minimal supervision. 
 2. Core Technology Stack TechnologyRequirementFrontendReact.js, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, CSS3BackendNode.js, Express.jsDatabasePostgreSQL, SQLCloudAmazon Web Services (AWS)APIsREST APIs, JSON, third-party integrationsSource controlGit, GitHubLanguagesJavaScript required; TypeScript preferredDeploymentAWS deployment, CI/CD workflowsSecurityAuthentication, authorization, RBAC, encryption, audit logging Candidates must demonstrate practical, hands-on experience with the primary stack, not only theoretical knowledge. 
 3. Primary Technical Responsibilities 
 A. Frontend Engineering Develop and maintain production React applications. Build responsive, reusable components and complex healthcare workflows. Implement dynamic assessment forms, conditional questionnaires, validations, dashboards and reporting interfaces. Develop appointment booking interfaces, calendars, scheduling controls and patient management screens. Implement role-aware navigation and interfaces. Handle asynchronous API communication, loading states, errors and form persistence. Improve frontend performance, accessibility and code maintainability. Troubleshoot and resolve existing interface and application defects. 
 B. Backend Engineering Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js. Design maintainable services with clear business logic and authorization boundaries. Implement robust data validation, error handling and standardized API responses. Develop background jobs for notifications, follow-ups, document processing and scheduled workflows. Integrate third-party APIs, webhooks, digital fax, email and external healthcare services. Implement secure document generation, PDF workflows and file handling. Prevent duplicate operations using transactions, idempotency controls and appropriate concurrency management. Develop structured logging, monitoring and reliable retry mechanisms. Troubleshoot performance, integration failures and production defects. 
 C. PostgreSQL and Database Engineering Design normalized relational schemas and maintain existing database structures. Write optimized SQL queries, joins, indexes, constraints and transactions. Create and manage database migrations. Implement relationships across pharmacies, patients, appointments, assessments and workflows. Enforce tenant-specific data isolation and permissions. Optimize query performance and investigate slow database operations. Support backup, restoration and data-integrity testing. Manage changes without corrupting historical records or compromising auditability. 
 D. AWS Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Candidates must be capable of independently working with AWS-hosted applications. Required experience includes: AWS EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3, IAM and CloudWatch. Familiarity with RDS and container deployment services where applicable. Staging and production environment configuration. Application deployment, monitoring and troubleshooting. HTTPS/TLS configuration, networking fundamentals and environment variables. IAM policies, secrets management and access restrictions. Database backup and recovery processes. Cloud performance optimization and resource-cost monitoring. Git-based CI/CD, automated tests, version control and rollback procedures. Production deployment under documented approval processes. Developers must understand both application code and the infrastructure needed to operate that code reliably. 4. Healthcare Software and Platform Architecture 
 A. Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture ZeeNovo serves multiple independent pharmacies and pharmacy groups. Developers must understand: Multi-tenant data architecture. Pharmacy-level data segregation. Organization, pharmacy, staff and patient relationships. Role-based access control at API and database levels. Permissions for pharmacy staff, managers, enterprise administrators and platform administrators. Shared services for authentication, booking, notifications and reporting. Secure cross-pharmacy administrative functions with explicit authorization. Scalable architecture that minimizes duplication between product modules. 
 B. Workflow Engineering Ability to translate business requirements into reliable workflows involving: Multi-step forms and assessments. Conditional logic and configurable rules. Status transitions and approvals. Automated follow-up scheduling and retries. Audit trails and historical record preservation. Reminders, notifications and escalation. Version-controlled clinical content and templates. Structured reporting and analytics. 
 C. API and External System Integration Experience integrating systems with: REST APIs and webhooks. API authentication and token management. External data mapping and validation. Error handling, rate limiting and retry controls. External system failures and reconciliation. Digital fax and email service providers. Integration testing using mock environments and sandbox credentials. 5. Product Development Responsibilities Developers may be assigned to one or more product tracks. 
 Track A — Clinical and Enterprise Responsibilities may include: Minor ailment and immunization assessment workflows. Appointment booking and central booking for pharmacy groups. Pharmacy selection, appointment-origin attribution and scheduling rules. Medication review and POCT modules. Automated patient follow-up, reminders and outcome tracking. PDF documentation and physician communication. Patient and pharmacy portals. Pharmacy microsites and administrative tools. Enterprise dashboards and permission-controlled reporting. Anonymized or appropriately aggregated operational analytics. 
 Track B — Assure and Magistral Responsibilities may include: Medication incident and near-miss reporting workflows. Province-specific data fields, validation and configurations. ISMP Canada NIDR/AIMS integration, subject to vendor onboarding and approval. API mapping, submission testing, response handling and reconciliation. CQI meeting management. Corrective and preventive action tracking. Staff competency assessments. Pharmacy self-assessment functionality. Compounding master formulas, version control and preparation records. Ingredient inventory, lot tracking, expiration dates and equipment records. Compounding documentation, calculations and PDF generation. Both tracks share common architecture, authentication, databases and infrastructure. 6. Healthcare Security and Privacy Requirements Because ZeeNovo processes sensitive health information, candidates must understand secure software development. Required capabilities: Authentication, MFA and secure session management. Role-based and resource-level authorization. Encryption in transit and at rest. Secure API access and input validation. Protection against SQL injection, XSS, CSRF and common OWASP vulnerabilities. Secure file uploads and document access. Audit logs for access, modifications and workflow activities. Tenant isolation and testing against unauthorized cross-pharmacy access. Secure handling of application credentials, secrets and tokens. Backup, recovery and incident investigation practices. Protection against automated registration abuse and API misuse. Preventing patient information from appearing in development logs, error reports or unapproved third-party tools. Developers are expected to help ZeeNovo implement technical safeguards appropriate to applicable Canadian privacy requirements, including Ontario's PHIPA and PIPEDA where applicable. Production patient data must not be copied to personal computers, unmanaged development environments or unauthorized AI services. Access to production systems must follow company authorization and least-privilege policies. 
 7. Software Quality and Engineering Standards Developers must follow a disciplined engineering process: Clean, maintainable, modular code. Reusable components and shared services. Meaningful unit and integration tests. Regression testing for existing workflows. Secure code reviews. Documented database migrations. Version-controlled repositories. Protected production branches. Separate development, staging and production environments. Testing before release and verification after deployment. Release notes, technical documentation and rollback plans. Root-cause analysis for recurring production incidents. Every significant feature should include its implementation, appropriate testing, documentation and deployment considerations. 
 8. Additional Technical Skills — Preferred The following are advantageous but not mandatory: TypeScript in React and Node.js applications. Docker and container-based deployments. AWS ECS, Lambda, SQS and Step Functions. GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD pipelines. Redis, caching and asynchronous processing. Automated UI testing using Playwright or Cypress. Healthcare interoperability experience, including HL7/FHIR concepts. Background in electronic health records, pharmacy software or healthcare SaaS. PDF generation, electronic signatures and document automation. Experience with AI APIs, structured LLM outputs and retrieval systems. Python for backend automation or document-processing services. Familiarity with Windows desktop applications, Electron or C#/.NET. Experience with these technologies is useful for future platform development, but demonstrated expertise in the current production stack is more important. 9. Future AI and Automation Development ZeeNovo is exploring future AI-assisted pharmacy workflow technology, including ZeeNovo Laminar. Potential work includes: Structured prescription and document intake. Data extraction and validation. Workflow orchestration and background tasks. Secure connectors to pharmacy management systems. Controlled desktop automation using Windows accessibility technologies. AI-assisted clinical and operational recommendations. Human approval, independent verification and comprehensive audit trails. This is a future development direction , not the initial position's primary responsibility. Experience with agentic systems, AI integrations or Windows services is an advantage. Developers must understand that AI systems cannot independently make final pharmacist clinical decisions or receive unrestricted access to patient records or pharmacy management systems. 
 10. Experience and Qualifications Mandatory Minimum 3 years of hands-on full-stack software development experience, preferably 3–6 years. Strong professional experience with React.js. Strong Node.js and Express.js development experience. Practical PostgreSQL database experience. Experience deploying and supporting production applications on AWS. Strong knowledge of REST APIs and system integrations. Proven ability to debug frontend, backend, database and infrastructure problems. Experience with Git, code reviews and collaborative development. Ability to independently own assigned features from requirements through delivery. Good written English communication and technical documentation. Preferred Production SaaS development experience. Multi-tenant application development. Experience handling regulated or sensitive data. Healthcare or pharmacy software development. Experience maintaining and modernizing an existing codebase rather than exclusively developing new applications. 
 11. Professional and Communication Expectations The selected developer should: Work independently with clearly defined deliverables. Provide transparent daily progress updates through Slack or approved tools. Raise technical blockers promptly. Participate in sprint planning and scheduled development reviews. Explain technical choices and trade-offs clearly. Maintain accurate development documentation. Estimate tasks realistically and communicate changes to timelines. Collaborate effectively with other developers and the Canadian management team. Identify reliability, security and scalability risks proactively. Avoid making unapproved architectural changes or production deployments. We value problem-solving ability, accountability, reliable execution and engineering judgment over the number of frameworks listed on a rsum. 12. Expected Performance During the First 90 Days 
 First 30 Days — Codebase and Infrastructure Understand ZeeNovo architecture and core modules. Set up the approved local development environment. Review application repositories, database structures and AWS deployment processes. Successfully deploy and test an existing application in staging. Resolve initial assigned bugs. Document identified technical issues and dependencies. 
 Days 31–60 — Independent Feature Delivery Independently develop and test an assigned full-stack feature. Create or update database schemas and API endpoints as needed. Implement appropriate security and authorization controls. Participate in code review and testing. Deliver the feature to staging and support an approved production release. Days 61–90 — Reliable Module Ownership Take responsibility for a defined module or development area. Deliver agreed milestones consistently. Troubleshoot bugs across frontend, backend, database and AWS. Maintain technical documentation and tests. Demonstrate an understanding of platform-wide dependencies. Show the ability to contribute without continuous technical supervision. 
 13. Employment and Working Arrangements Previously discussed employment parameters: Work location: India, remote. Employment type: Fixed-term employee, initially 12 months. Working days: Monday to Saturday. Working hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM IST; Saturday, 10:00 AM–5:00 PM IST. Weekly rest day: Sunday. Paid national holidays: 10 days as previously proposed. Notice period proposed: 90 days. Equipment: Employee-provided computer and reliable internet, subject to approved endpoint security requirements. Reporting: ZeeNovo management and designated technical leads. Final employment arrangements, statutory benefits, leave, notice provisions and working-time requirements will be confirmed in accordance with applicable Indian employment law. 
 14. Application Requirements Candidates should submit: Updated CV with relevant work experience. Brief description of production React, Node.js and PostgreSQL projects. Details of AWS applications they have personally deployed or maintained. Examples of technical ownership, complex bug resolution or system integration. GitHub profile or code samples, where available and permitted. Current compensation, compensation expectations and availability to join. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment and engineering interview. ZeeNovo Health® — Building connected infrastructure for modern pharmacy practice.

Location: Ahmedabad, India-Remote Company Introduction As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace for the last 5 years (2021-2025) with a rating of 4.3 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor, and 4.4 stars out of 5 on AmbitionBox. Our team members love our competitive benefits, including remote work options, comfortable work-life balance, paid time off (PTO), personal and family health insurance options, paid family leave, and development/training opportunities. Job Role We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer I/II (iOS) to own the full lifecycle of our native iOS applications, from design and development through release and maintenance. You will build secure, high-quality, scalable apps for iPhone and iPad using Swift and SwiftUI, following modern architectures such as MVVM and Clean Architecture. You will work on features that power Genea s platform, including mobile credentials, access control, and connected IoT devices over Bluetooth Low Energy, NFC, and Apple Wallet pass provisioning. Working closely with UI/UX designers, software testers, and backend engineers, you will bring expertise in reactive programming, networking, multithreading, memory management, and mobile security, and help drive continuous improvement across our agile process and CI/CD pipelines. Responsibilities Actively participate in the entire iOS application lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, release, and maintenance. Design, implement, and maintain features on our iOS app platform using Swift and SwiftUI. Conceptualize and build apps that work well across all Apple devices and screen sizes, including iPhone and iPad. Develop features that communicate with IoT hardware such as access control readers, locks, and sensors over Bluetooth Low Energy (Core Bluetooth) and NFC (Core NFC). Implement and maintain Apple Wallet integrations, including PassKit and in-app pass provisioning for mobile access credentials. Build robust networking layers to integrate with REST APIs and backend services, handling authentication, error states, retries, and offline scenarios. Implement security best practices to protect user data and credentials, including Keychain, Secure Enclave, encryption, and certificate pinning. Implement and maintain push notifications (APNs / FCM) and background tasks. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, software testers, backend engineers, and hardware teams to ensure app presentation and functionality meet requirements and Apple s Human Interface Guidelines. Write clean, testable code; review peers code and rectify errors before app releases. Profile and optimize app performance, memory usage, and battery consumption. Own and improve iOS CI/CD pipelines, code signing, provisioning profiles, and TestFlight / App Store release processes. Monitor app reviews, crash reports, and analytics to identify areas for improvement. Recommend and implement process and technology improvements. Provide training, mentorship, and support to team members. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI, with working knowledge of UIKit and interoperability between the two. Practical knowledge of iOS app architecture, design, implementation, and release, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, and modular app design. Hands-on experience with RxSwift; familiarity with Combine and Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors) is a plus. Strong grasp of Swift language features, including protocols, generics, closures, and higher-order functions (map, filter, reduce, compactMap). Dependency management with CocoaPods and Swift Package Manager, and strong troubleshooting skills for resolving dependency conflicts. Experience building apps that integrate with IoT devices. Knowledge of Bluetooth Low Energy using Core Bluetooth, including scanning, pairing, GATT services, background modes, and connection reliability. Experience with NFC using Core NFC (tag reading/writing and NFC-based access use cases). Experience with Apple Wallet and PassKit, including in-app pass provisioning and mobile credential workflows. Solid understanding of networking: REST APIs, URLSession, asynchronous request handling, JSON parsing, authentication (OAuth, tokens), and offline storage/sync. Security background: Keychain, Secure Enclave, biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID), data encryption, certificate/SSL pinning, and awareness of OWASP Mobile Top 10. Good understanding of multithreading using GCD, OperationQueue, and Swift Concurrency. Experience with background tasks and background execution modes on iOS. Knowledge of iOS memory management (ARC, retain cycles, weak/unowned references) and performance profiling with Instruments. Experience with push notifications using APNs and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM). Experience with local storage such as Core Data, Realm, or SQLite. Familiarity with agile development techniques and CI/CD for iOS (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Bitrise, or Xcode Cloud), code signing, and App Store Connect / TestFlight. Experience writing unit and UI tests using XCTest. Solid understanding of SDLC and agile methodologies. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of experience in native iOS application development using Swift. Portfolio of iOS apps published on the App Store, with evidence of contributions across the full development lifecycle. Experience in any domain is welcome; experience with security, access control, IoT, or hardware-connected products is highly preferred. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly. Competencies Diversity - Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; Educates others on the value of diversity; Promotes a harassment-free environment; Builds a diverse workforce. title: Senior PAS Delivery Architect
description:
Senior PAS Delivery Architect Scitara Service Delivery Product Application Services 
 
 Senior PAS Delivery Architect 
 Product Application Services Scitara DLX Implementation Validation Location Pune / Mumbai, India Department Department Service Delivery Experience Experience 10+ years lab informatics architecture connectivity Education Education Bachelors or Masters (CS / Life Sciences / related) The role in one sentence You lead the configuration, implementation and validation of the Scitara DLX platform for global pharma and life-sciences customers owning delivery quality, guiding customers to scalable, compliant solutions , and building a high-performing PAS team . 
 
 Why Scitara 
 A fast-growing, globally recognized platform revolutionizing lab connectivity in pharma and life sciences. Scitara DLX connects laboratory instruments, applications, data and people. Work at the forefront of AI-driven lab automation and advanced integration the move toward smart labs . Collaborate with industry-leading experts and contribute directly to scientific innovation at global scale. 
 
 About the Role 
 Customer-facing leadership role in Scitaras Services organization. Leads configuration, implementation and validation of DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Works across Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture and Customer Success to deliver high-impact outcomes. Requires technical architecture and instrument-connectivity expertise , consulting skills and a strong sense of ownership . 
 
 One role, three strengths 
 
 Delivery Leader 
 Owns implementation and validation outcomes for DLX customers 
 
 Technical Architect 
 Designs instrument and system connectivity with GxP depth 
 
 Team Builder 
 Mentors the PAS team and raises its capability and standards 
 
 Delivery ownership 
 You lead PAS delivery across the DLX lifecycle 01 Discover 02 Design Input 03 Configure 04 Implement 05 Validate 06 Hand Over Reuse 
 
 This role IS 
 Hands-on delivery leadership of DLX implementations. Customer-facing discovery calls, demos and value-based recommendations. Leading and mentoring PAS team members in an Agile delivery model. Balancing technical depth with business alignment . 
 
 This role is NOT 
 A functional LIMS/ELN configuration or ticket-resolution role. People management without technical depth you stay close to the solution. A pure pre-sales or demo role you stay accountable through validation. Order-taking you translate needs into sound technical requirements. A CSV-only role although you need a good understanding of CSV/CSA . 
 
 What you will do 
 Core responsibilities 
 
 1 Implementation Validation Delivery 
 Lead the implementation and validation of Scitara DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Own the technical architecture for instrument and system connectivity scalable, compliant and robust . Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements , working closely with Software Application Specialists. Ensure delivery meets GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ and GAMP 5 expectations. 
 
 2 Customer Engagement Consulting 
 Participate in customer calls drive discovery , influence solution design and give value-oriented technical recommendations . Deliver effective product demonstrations and communicate DLXs value proposition clearly. Engage stakeholders through consultative, value-based storytelling including at executive level. 
 
 3 Team Leadership Capability 
 Mentor and guide PAS team members; build a culture of excellence, innovation and continuous learning. Work in or lead Agile delivery teams ; align team execution with company objectives. Drive performance and operational efficiency across PAS engagements. Champion knowledge sharing, best practices and internal training within PAS. 
 
 4 Cross-Functional Alignment Assets 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects and Software Engineers for smooth handovers and cohesive outcomes. Align delivery strategies with Scitaras business objectives and product roadmap . Contribute to technical documentation, internal playbooks and customer-facing collateral . 
 
 Extended scope (good to have) 
 Not mandatory; candidates who show these will be preferred 
 
 Value Discovery Consulting 
 Lead discovery workshops; quantify value and define success criteria. Challenge unnecessary customization ; steer customers toward standard, scalable approaches. 
 
 Scalable, Reusable Patterns 
 Establish First-of-Kind integration patterns and Adaptive Workflows . Drive configuration-led reuse across equivalent instruments, labs and sites. 
 
 Forward-Deployed Bridging 
 Surface cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies before they block delivery. Provide technical continuity from discovery through deployment and Hypercare. 
 
 Proof of Value Production Readiness 
 Support or lead PoV and pilot engagements. Prove scalability, operability and reuse not only functionality. 
 
 AI-Enabled Lab Transformation 
 Translate AI agents and automation into practical RD and QC use cases. Show how standardized, contextualized data enables AI/ML. 
 
 Commercial Input 
 Review SOWs, estimates and assumptions so commitments are technically achievable. Feed delivery experience back into product and methodology . 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 DLX implementations are delivered on time, validated and audit-ready . Customers see you as a trusted technical advisor , not just a delivery resource. Solutions are scalable and supportable not one-off configurations. The PAS team grows more capable through your mentoring, playbooks and training. 
 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the move toward smart labs with AI-driven automation and advanced integration. Work with industry-leading experts and some of the brightest minds in science. Enable breakthroughs that accelerate RD and improve data-driven decisions globally. A dynamic culture of continuous learning, creativity and growth . 
 
 What you bring 
 Must have first, then good to have Must have 10+ years in pharma/life-sciences lab informatics, with strong technical architecture skills designing how instruments, LIMS/ELN/LES/CDS and enterprise systems connect. Technical configuration of LIMS/ELN for instrument connectivity interfaces, instrument data capture, parsing and mapping, and data flows between instruments and systems. Enterprise integration : REST APIs, JSON/XML, file-based interfaces, data mapping, error handling and retry. Customer-facing consultative experience leading discovery, translating needs into technical requirements, and influencing stakeholders through persuasive, value-based storytelling . Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Life Sciences or a related field. Strong pharma and life-sciences domain knowledge, including QC and RD laboratory processes and regulatory expectations. Working knowledge of lab instruments and their software like Empower, Chromeleon, SoftMax Pro, Tecan Magellan, UNICORN/KTA, LabX (and controlled instruments such as pH meters and balances). Well versed in 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+, GAMP 5 and GxP , with a good understanding of CSV (validation planning, risk-based testing, traceability). This is not a CSV-only role . Experience working in or leading Agile teams . Able to balance technical depth with business alignment contributing to both strategic planning and hands-on delivery. Good to have Technical Scripting in JavaScript and/or Python . Data platforms (databases, data lakes) and cloud infrastructure, especially AWS . Data standards such as ASM, AnIML and SiLA . Event-driven integration , monitoring tools, deployment frameworks or infrastructure automation. CSA (Computer Software Assurance) alongside CSV. Good to have AI Practical familiarity with Generative AI / LLMs, agentic AI, prompt and context engineering, RAG and AI-assisted development. Evidence of self-directed AI learning courses, prototypes or automations you built yourself. Good to have Background Prior role as applications scientist, lab informatics specialist, lab manager or scientist . Experience across multiple systems, vendors, labs or sites . Experience leading Proof-of-Value or pilot engagements. Please note: functional LIMS/ELN/LES implementation or business configuration experience on its own does not meet this bar . We need technical architecture, instrument-connectivity depth and customer consulting experience. 
 
 How you work 
 Core attributes, plus valued extras 
 
 Customer-centric mindset 
 Consultative; identifies pain points and delivers tailored solutions. 
 
 Strategic alignment 
 Understands Scitaras vision and product roadmap, and delivers toward it. 
 
 Domain-aware execution 
 Considers the broader needs of the pharma and life-sciences sector. 
 
 Storytelling communication 
 Explains complex concepts with clarity and conviction in demos and executive discussions. 
 
 Ownership 
 Stays accountable for delivery outcomes and drives issues to closure. 
 
 Team leadership 
 Mentors, sets standards and builds a culture of continuous learning. 
 
 Constructive challenge Good to have 
 Good to have Professionally pushes back when evidence or customer outcomes require it. 
 
 Influence without authority Good to have 
 Good to have Mobilizes teams and vendors across organizational boundaries. 
 
 Curiosity, especially AI Good to have 
 Good to have Actively experiments with AI and modern software practices. 
 
 Commercial awareness Good to have 
 Good to have Knows how technical choices affect effort, risk and total cost of ownership.

 Location: Sector 116, Noida
 Employment Type: Full-time | In-office
 Working Days: 6 days/week
 Experience: 03 years
 CTC: 3.6–4.8 LPA + Performance-Linked Bonus
 Reports to: COO / Founders About POBO POBO — Power of Being One — is a real-estate startup building a tech-enabled platform around buyer collectives. We bring together individuals with similar property requirements so they can negotiate with the collective power, price advantage and protection traditionally available to institutional buyers. Our proposition: Where Individuals Buy Like Institutions. We are currently building the business from the ground up — across technology, operations, customer acquisition, partnerships and real-estate transactions. About the Role We are looking for a Business Operations & Growth Associate who wants to learn how a startup is actually built from the inside. This is not a narrow operations or desk-only role. You will work closely with POBO’s founders across business operations, growth, marketing, research, data, technology, AI and execution . Some problems will come with a process. Many won’t. We are looking for someone who can take an ambiguous task, figure out what needs to be done and take it from idea research plan execution . What You’ll Work On Business Operations Track business priorities, projects and deliverables. Coordinate across teams, vendors and external partners. Build and maintain trackers, processes and documentation. Follow up on deliverables and help turn plans into execution. Growth & Marketing Support digital, performance, community and offline marketing initiatives. Coordinate content, campaigns, social media and marketing experiments. Track leads, campaigns and customer acquisition initiatives. Help test new channels and growth ideas. Research & Business Development Research real-estate projects, developers, markets, customers, competitors and pricing. Identify potential partnerships and business opportunities. Maintain structured databases and convert research into actionable insights. Data & Insights Work with Excel/Google Sheets, lead data, funnels, trackers and dashboards. Analyse business information and present clear insights to the founders. Help identify gaps, trends and opportunities from business data. Product, Technology & AI Test POBO’s app, CRM and digital workflows. Identify bugs and coordinate with developers. Evaluate tools for calling, WhatsApp, SMS, hosting, CRM and other business requirements. Use AI tools to improve research, productivity, marketing and internal processes. Founder Projects Work directly on high-priority projects with the founders. Take cross-functional assignments from research to implementation. Support vendor coordination, documentation and operational problem-solving. Market Exposure Interact with customers, partners, vendors and local networks when required. Understand the real-estate market through actual execution, not just online research. Who We’re Looking For Education Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Candidates from Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Technology, Architecture or related backgrounds are welcome. Your ability to think and execute matters more to us than your degree. Experience 0–3 years of experience in operations, founder’s office, growth, consulting, business development, project coordination or a startup environment. Strong fresh graduates with relevant internships, projects or demonstrated ownership are encouraged to apply. Skills Strong written and verbal communication. Good research and problem-solving ability. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and presentations. Comfortable using AI tools. Familiarity with CRM, analytics, no-code tools, performance marketing or technology is a bonus. The Kind of Person Who Will Do Well Here You are someone who: Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions for every step. Can figure things out even when there is no existing playbook. Follows through and doesn’t need to be constantly chased. Flags problems early instead of hiding them. Is comfortable handling multiple priorities. Asks good questions and communicates clearly. Enjoys learning new tools and solving unfamiliar problems. Is genuinely curious about startups, technology, consumer behaviour, business and/or real estate. Compensation Fixed CTC: 3.6–4.8 LPA Equivalent to approximately 30,000–40,000 per month , depending on experience, capability and role fit. Plus performance-linked bonuses based on clearly defined individual and business outcomes. As POBO grows, strong performers will have the opportunity to take ownership of larger workstreams, manage projects independently and grow into broader operations / founder’s office responsibilities. Why Join POBO? Work directly with the founders. See how an early-stage company is actually built. Exposure across operations, growth, marketing, product, technology, AI, research and real estate. Work on real business problems instead of repetitive support tasks. Take ownership of projects you can directly point to. Opportunity for significantly greater responsibility as the company grows. We care more about initiative, integrity, curiosity and execution than titles and credentials. Selection Process Application Founder Conversation Short Practical Assignment Final Discussion When applying, please share your CV along with a brief note about one task, project or initiative that you independently took from start to completion. title: Head Engineering
description:
Position Dossier - Head of Engineering 
 
 Static Equipment Manufacturing Company 
 Initial Location: Faridabad, Haryana

 Reporting To: CEO

 About the Company 
 
Company is a leading Indian engineering and heavy fabrication company with over five decades of experience in the design, engineering and manufacture of process equipment and static equipment for the energy and process industries. 
 
Established in 1970, the company has evolved from a specialist manufacturer of industrial filtration products into a diversified engineering organization serving customers across India and international markets.
 
It is a part of a large auto components group, one of India's leading diversified engineering and manufacturing groups with over five decades of industrial excellence. The Group operates multiple state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities across India, has an extensive global footprint, and serves leading OEMs and industrial customers across sectors including Automotive, Oil &Gas, Defence, Railways, Consumer Electronics, Process Industries and Engineering.
 
Today, the company's core business comprises the design and manufacture of high-value static process equipment and engineered packages for the Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemical, Chemical, Power, Steel, Fertilizer and Process industries.
 
Its product portfolio includes Modular Skids, Gas Conditioning Systems, Filter Separators, Strainers, Oil & Water Separators, Two- and Three-Phase Separators, Water Bath Heaters, Deaerators, Heat Exchangers, Pressure Vessels, Reactors, Columns, Knock-Out Drums, Silencers, Diesel Separators and other customized process equipment. The company specializes in heavy fabrication and pressure equipment manufactured in accordance with ASME and other international codes and standards.
 
It is an ISO-certified organization and is authorized for ASME 'U', 'U2' and 'R' stamps. The company is an approved vendor to leading EPC contractors and end users and has supplied equipment to projects across more than 20 countries worldwide.
The company's primary manufacturing facility is located in, Faridabad, with a two-acre fabrication yard supported by an adjacent two-acre storage yard. As part of its strategic expansion, it has established an additional fabrication facility at Dahej, Gujarat, with another coastal manufacturing facility under development.
The organization employs approximately 500 people, including around 100 technical and managerial staff.
 
The company is on an accelerated growth trajectory, targeting revenues of approximately INR 150 crore in the current financial year, up from INR 88 crore in the previous year. The company aims to achieve revenues of INR 225 crore over the next two years and INR 500 crore within the next five years through capacity expansion, product diversification and continued growth in domestic and international markets.
 
 

 Position Overview 
The Head Engineering will provide strategic and operational leadership for the complete engineering function of the company encompassing Process Engineering, Mechanical Design, Static Equipment Engineering, Detailed Engineering, Project Engineering, Drafting, Engineering Documentation and Manufacturing Engineering.
 
The incumbent will be responsible for engineering delivery of custom-built static process equipment and modular systems for the Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemical, Chemical and Process industries. The role demands deep technical expertise in pressure vessel engineering, process equipment design, heavy fabrication and ASME code compliance, while ensuring engineering excellence throughout the project lifecyclefrom enquiry and proposal engineering to detailed design, manufacturing support, inspection and commissioning.
The position will play a critical role in strengthening engineering capabilities, driving standardization, reducing engineering cycle times, supporting capacity expansion and establishing engineering systems for the company's next phase of growth.

 Educational Qualification 
 B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering (Mandatory) M.Tech., MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred Additional certifications in Pressure Vessel Design, ASME Codes, Welding Engineering or Project Management will be an advantage 
 Experience 
 Minimum 20 years of progressively responsible experience in heavy engineering or process equipment manufacturing At least 10 years in a senior engineering leadership position Extensive experience in engineering of: Pressure Vessels Heat Exchangers Process Columns Reactors Knock-Out Drums Separators Water Bath Heaters Gas Conditioning Packages Modular Process Skids Filtration & Separation Systems Strong exposure to fabrication of carbon steel, stainless steel and alloy steel pressure equipment Experience working with EPC companies, licensors and international customers Hands-on knowledge of design, fabrication and inspection requirements for ASME coded equipment 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Engineering Leadership 
 Lead the complete engineering organization including Mechanical Design, Process Engineering, Drafting, Project Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering. Develop engineering strategy aligned with business growth plans. Establish engineering best practices, technical governance and engineering KPIs. Build a high-performance engineering organization capable of supporting significant business expansion. 
 Mechanical Design Engineering

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Engineering Manager 
 About Us: We are a profitable health-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive. 
 The Role: The Permanent Player-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone-wolf architect. This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest. 
 Experience Range: 12 to 15 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience. The 6-Month Trajectory: Months 1-2 (Heavy Architecture): Your focus will be architecting the AWS-to-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team. Months 3-6+ (The Steady State): You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role. You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1-on-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery. Youll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities: Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem. Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep. Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories. Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt. Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise-grade engineers. Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap. Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders. 
 Requirements: 12 to 15 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey). Senior-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus. Deep, practical, hands-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs. Experience integrating complex third-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes. High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one. Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS*, GCP, Azure)

title: In-Memory/Redis Database Platform Engineer
description:
We are seeking an In-Memory Database Platform Engineer to join the Database Engineering team and help build, operate, and modernize enterprise in-memory database services. This mid-level role will support on-premises Redis deployments and multiple cloud-managed in-memory database offerings, with an emphasis on reliable operations, automation, security, performance, high availability, backup and recovery, and consistent engineering practices. The ideal candidate has practical Redis administration experience, solid Linux skills, and hands-on exposure to one or more cloud in-memory database services. The engineer will work closely with application, infrastructure, security, SRE, network, and cloud engineering teams while continuing to grow platform-design and troubleshooting expertise. In-Memory Database Platform Engineering Build, deploy, administer, and support production and non-production Redis environments across on-premises infrastructure and cloud-managed in-memory database services. Perform installation, configuration, patching, version upgrades, migrations, lifecycle management, and routine platform maintenance. Support Redis standalone, replication, and clustered architectures as applicable to the platform and workload. Apply engineering standards, reference configurations, operational controls, and documented best practices. Partner with application teams on connectivity, caching patterns, key design, data structures, performance, resilience, and operational readiness. Multi-Cloud In-Memory Services Support managed in-memory database offerings such as Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey, Amazon MemoryDB, Azure Managed Redis, and Google Cloud Memorystore, based on enterprise platform direction. Assist with provisioning, configuration, scaling, maintenance, monitoring, networking, access management, and migration activities across cloud environments. Help maintain consistent security, reliability, observability, and operational practices across on-premises and cloud implementations. High Availability, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection Configure and support highly available Redis solutions using replication, clustering, multi-zone, or cloud-native resiliency capabilities. Configure and operate persistence, snapshot, backup, retention, restore, and recovery-validation processes where supported and required by the service. Performance and Reliability Monitor database availability, memory utilization, latency, throughput, replication health, capacity, and platform performance. Analyze and tune Redis configurations, memory policies, data structures, client behavior, connection patterns, hot keys, and workload characteristics. Troubleshoot production incidents, contribute to root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Participate in capacity planning, observability, operational health, and reliability improvements. Security and Compliance Implement and maintain authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, network controls, auditing, and credential-management integrations. Support private connectivity and identity/access controls for cloud-managed services. Assist with vulnerability remediation, compliance reviews, security assessments, and evidence requests. Automation and DevOps Develop and maintain automation for provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching, validation, monitoring, and routine operations. Use source control, APIs, CI/CD practices, configuration management, and Infrastructure as Code to improve consistency and repeatability. Contribute to safe self-service capabilities and reduction of manual operational work. Platform Operations Provide operational support for business-critical production and non-production in-memory database environments. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, change management, and problem management. Create and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, standards, and operational documentation. Work independently on standard engineering tasks and partner with senior engineers on complex designs, migrations, and incidents. Required Qualifications 8+ years of database administration, database engineering, platform engineering, or related infrastructure experience. 4+ years of hands-on Redis administration or engineering experience in production or enterprise environments. Working knowledge of Redis architecture, persistence, replication, clustering, memory management, security, maintenance, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with high availability, backup/recovery or persistence strategies, monitoring, capacity planning, and production support. Experience supporting at least one cloud-managed in-memory database service or comparable cloud database platform. Solid Linux administration and troubleshooting skills; RHEL or a comparable enterprise Linux distribution is preferred. Ability to troubleshoot database, operating system, storage, network, client-connectivity, and application-integration issues. Experience executing upgrades, patching, migrations, platform changes, and controlled production releases. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with more than one cloud in-memory offering, especially Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey, Amazon MemoryDB, Azure Managed Redis, or Google Cloud Memorystore. Experience with Redis Enterprise or Redis Software for on-premises platform management. Experience with Ansible automation for installation, configuration, patching, validation, or recurring operational tasks. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and delivery tooling such as Terraform.

title: Senior PAS Delivery Architect

Senior PAS Delivery Architect Scitara Service Delivery Product Application Services 
 
 Senior PAS Delivery Architect 
 Product Application Services Scitara DLX Implementation Validation Location Pune / Mumbai, India Department Department Service Delivery Experience Experience 10+ years lab informatics architecture connectivity Education Education Bachelors or Masters (CS / Life Sciences / related) The role in one sentence You lead the configuration, implementation and validation of the Scitara DLX platform for global pharma and life-sciences customers owning delivery quality, guiding customers to scalable, compliant solutions , and building a high-performing PAS team . 
 
 Why Scitara 
 A fast-growing, globally recognized platform revolutionizing lab connectivity in pharma and life sciences. Scitara DLX connects laboratory instruments, applications, data and people. Work at the forefront of AI-driven lab automation and advanced integration the move toward smart labs . Collaborate with industry-leading experts and contribute directly to scientific innovation at global scale. 
 
 About the Role 
 Customer-facing leadership role in Scitaras Services organization. Leads configuration, implementation and validation of DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Works across Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture and Customer Success to deliver high-impact outcomes. Requires technical architecture and instrument-connectivity expertise , consulting skills and a strong sense of ownership . 
 
 One role, three strengths 
 
 Delivery Leader 
 Owns implementation and validation outcomes for DLX customers 
 
 Technical Architect 
 Designs instrument and system connectivity with GxP depth 
 
 Team Builder 
 Mentors the PAS team and raises its capability and standards 
 
 Delivery ownership 
 You lead PAS delivery across the DLX lifecycle 01 Discover 02 Design Input 03 Configure 04 Implement 05 Validate 06 Hand Over Reuse 
 
 This role IS 
 Hands-on delivery leadership of DLX implementations. Customer-facing discovery calls, demos and value-based recommendations. Leading and mentoring PAS team members in an Agile delivery model. Balancing technical depth with business alignment . 
 
 This role is NOT 
 A functional LIMS/ELN configuration or ticket-resolution role. People management without technical depth you stay close to the solution. A pure pre-sales or demo role you stay accountable through validation. Order-taking you translate needs into sound technical requirements. A CSV-only role although you need a good understanding of CSV/CSA . 
 
 What you will do 
 Core responsibilities 
 
 1 Implementation Validation Delivery 
 Lead the implementation and validation of Scitara DLX for global pharma and life-sciences customers. Own the technical architecture for instrument and system connectivity scalable, compliant and robust . Translate customer needs into clear technical requirements , working closely with Software Application Specialists. Ensure delivery meets GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ and GAMP 5 expectations. 
 
 2 Customer Engagement Consulting 
 Participate in customer calls drive discovery , influence solution design and give value-oriented technical recommendations . Deliver effective product demonstrations and communicate DLXs value proposition clearly. Engage stakeholders through consultative, value-based storytelling including at executive level. 
 
 3 Team Leadership Capability 
 Mentor and guide PAS team members; build a culture of excellence, innovation and continuous learning. Work in or lead Agile delivery teams ; align team execution with company objectives. Drive performance and operational efficiency across PAS engagements. Champion knowledge sharing, best practices and internal training within PAS. 
 
 4 Cross-Functional Alignment Assets 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Solution Architects and Software Engineers for smooth handovers and cohesive outcomes. Align delivery strategies with Scitaras business objectives and product roadmap . Contribute to technical documentation, internal playbooks and customer-facing collateral . 
 
 Extended scope (good to have) 
 Not mandatory; candidates who show these will be preferred 
 
 Value Discovery Consulting 
 Lead discovery workshops; quantify value and define success criteria. Challenge unnecessary customization ; steer customers toward standard, scalable approaches. 
 
 Scalable, Reusable Patterns 
 Establish First-of-Kind integration patterns and Adaptive Workflows . Drive configuration-led reuse across equivalent instruments, labs and sites. 
 
 Forward-Deployed Bridging 
 Surface cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies before they block delivery. Provide technical continuity from discovery through deployment and Hypercare. 
 
 Proof of Value Production Readiness 
 Support or lead PoV and pilot engagements. Prove scalability, operability and reuse not only functionality. 
 
 AI-Enabled Lab Transformation 
 Translate AI agents and automation into practical RD and QC use cases. Show how standardized, contextualized data enables AI/ML. 
 
 Commercial Input 
 Review SOWs, estimates and assumptions so commitments are technically achievable. Feed delivery experience back into product and methodology . 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 DLX implementations are delivered on time, validated and audit-ready . Customers see you as a trusted technical advisor , not just a delivery resource. Solutions are scalable and supportable not one-off configurations. The PAS team grows more capable through your mentoring, playbooks and training. 
 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the move toward smart labs with AI-driven automation and advanced integration. Work with industry-leading experts and some of the brightest minds in science. Enable breakthroughs that accelerate RD and improve data-driven decisions globally. A dynamic culture of continuous learning, creativity and growth . 
 
 What you bring

 Job Description 
 Overview We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist with strong tech lead capabilities to spearhead our AI and machine learning initiatives end to end. This is not a pure research role you will architect, build, and ship production-grade AI systems while mentoring a multidisciplinary team of data scientists and ML engineers. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on expertise across Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Computer Vision (CV), and classical ML, combined with a strong understanding of system architecture, scalable infrastructure, and MLOps. You will serve as the technical authority on all things AI from selecting the right model architecture to designing the serving layer and ensuring reliability in production. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of AI/ML solutions across LLM, VLM, computer vision, and traditional ML domains. Define and own the AI/ML technical architecture model pipelines, training infrastructure, feature stores, and serving systems. Build and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for domain-specific applications (e.g., RAG, agents, multimodal understanding). Design and deploy production-grade computer vision systems (object detection, segmentation, OCR, video analytics) at scale. Develop and maintain classical ML models (regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting, recommendation engines) where appropriate. Architect scalable, low-latency model serving infrastructure for both batch and real-time inference workloads. Establish best practices for experiment tracking, model versioning, A/B testing, reproducibility, and documentation across the team. Mentor and technically lead a team of data scientists and ML engineers; conduct architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to translate complex business problems into well-defined AI solutions. Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and research papers into the product roadmap. Champion responsible AI fairness, bias detection, explainability, and compliance with data privacy regulations. Communicate technical strategies, trade-offs, and results to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. Required Qualifications 7+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, or AI engineering. Deep expertise in LLMs fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, embedding models, and LLM evaluation frameworks. Strong hands-on experience with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or similar multimodal architectures. Proven track record in computer vision — CNNs, transformers (ViT, DETR, SAM), object detection (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), segmentation, OCR, and video understanding. Solid command of classical ML techniques — ensemble methods, gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), Bayesian methods, and time-series modeling. Strong proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, or equivalent). Production ML experience — building, deploying, and monitoring models in real-world systems with SLA requirements. Solid understanding of ML system architecture — feature engineering pipelines, model registries, CI/CD for ML, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and GPU-accelerated training infrastructure. Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical teams, drive architecture decisions, and deliver projects on time. Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI concepts for diverse audiences. Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field preferred. Technical Depth Expected LLMs & NLP: Tokenization, attention mechanisms, transformer architectures, RLHF/DPO, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus), chunking strategies, and retrieval-augmented generation. VLMs & Multimodal AI: Image-text alignment, contrastive learning (CLIP), multimodal embeddings, visual question answering, and document understanding models. Computer Vision: Image classification, object detection, instance/semantic segmentation, pose estimation, depth estimation, generative models (diffusion, GANs), and edge deployment (ONNX, TensorRT). Classical ML: Feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model selection, cross-validation, drift detection, and explainability (SHAP, LIME). Production Systems: Model optimization (quantization, pruning, distillation), A/B testing frameworks, shadow deployments, autoscaling inference endpoints, and latency profiling. Nice to Have Experience building agentic AI systems (tool use, multi-step reasoning, autonomous workflows). Familiarity with MLOps platforms (MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases, Vertex AI, SageMaker). Publications, patents, or significant open-source contributions in AI/ML. Experience with synthetic data generation and data augmentation strategies. Background in reinforcement learning or optimization techniques. Exposure to edge AI / on-device model deployment (mobile, IoT). Experience working in fast-paced startup or high-growth environments. Knowledge of data governance, model risk management, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

 Athena Infonomics is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented intern to support the Business Development team with knowledge management, database maintenance, lead research, CRM updates, and proposal support. The intern will help maintain Athena s external expert CV database, standardize documents into proposal-ready formats, update business development records, and support research and coordination activities.

Update, validate, and standardize information to improve accuracy and usability. Review records and documents for completeness, consistency, and accuracy. 2. Lead Identification and CRM Support Identify, screen, and post potential business opportunities through procurement portals, public databases, and secondary research. Update and maintain Salesforce CRM with lead details, opportunity status, deadlines, and proposal progress. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across the business development pipeline.4. Market, Partner, and 4. Competitor Research Conduct research on potential partners and competitors. Review their sector expertise, relevant experience, and geographic presence. Compile available Points of Contact to support capture and partnership activities. 5. Proposal and Pre-Proposal Support Assist with document collection, CV formatting, and compliance checks against RFI and RFP requirements. Support the preparation and maintenance of proposal trackers and supporting documents. Assist with meetings, calls, and follow-ups with clients, partners, experts, and internal stakeholders. 6. Use of AI and Digital Tools Use AI-enabled tools and digital platforms to support research, information management, content structuring, and document preparation. Review and validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and quality. 7. Administrative and Coordination Support Support the maintenance of templates, trackers, repositories, and other organizational resources. Provide coordination and administrative support for knowledge management and business development activities. Track assigned tasks and ensure timely completion. Required Skills and Qualifications Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor s or master s degree in information management, data management, business administration, development studies, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field. Learning Opportunities The intern will gain practical exposure to knowledge management, database management, business development, proposal support, market research, Salesforce CRM, and AI-enabled workflows in an international development consulting environment.

Operating at the core of Expedia's transaction platform, our systems process millions of orders and updates daily, ensuring reliability, consistency, and auditability across brands and channels through domain-driven APIs. Join us to shape and scale the ordering platform that underpins Expedia Group's global travel marketplace. As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate key components of Expedia Group's Ordering Services platform, powering critical booking, reservation, and order management experiences across the travel ecosystem. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, scalable, and reliable services that support order creation, modification, fulfilment, and lifecycle management while ensuring a seamless experience for travelers and partner teams. In this role, you will: Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance services and applications, contributing to end-to-end feature delivery across multiple domains. title: Engineering Manager
description:
Engineering Manager 
 About Us: We are a profitable health-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive. 
 The Role: The Permanent Player-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone-wolf architect. This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest. 
 Experience Range: 12 to 15 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience. The 6-Month Trajectory: Months 1-2 (Heavy Architecture): Your focus will be architecting the AWS-to-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team. Months 3-6+ (The Steady State): You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role. You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1-on-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery. Youll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities: Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem. Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep. Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories. Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt. Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise-grade engineers. Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap. Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders. 
 Requirements: 12 to 15 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey). Senior-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus. Deep, practical, hands-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs. Experience integrating complex third-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes. High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one. Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS*, GCP, Azure)

title: EYP - Strategy - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. JOB DESCRIPTION Associate Director AI Strategy EY-Parthenon | EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Role Overview EY GDS is seeking a highly experienced Associate Director - AI Strategy to lead the development and execution of AI-led business transformation engagements within EY-Parthenon s global strategy consulting practice. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, artificial intelligence, generative AI, data analytics, digital transformation and value creation. The Associate Director will partner with global EY-Parthenon leadership and client executives to shape enterprise AI strategies, identify growth and efficiency opportunities, establish AI governance frameworks and deliver large-scale AI transformation programmes. The individual will play a critical role in building EY-Parthenon s AI Strategy capabilities across GDS while supporting client pursuits, thought leadership, innovation initiatives and high-impact transformation engagements. Key Responsibilities AI Strategy Enterprise Transformation Lead AI strategy engagements for Fortune 500 and private equity-backed organisations across sectors. Advise C-suite executives on AI-enabled growth, operating model transformation, productivity enhancement and innovation opportunities. Develop enterprise AI and Generative AI roadmaps aligned to business and value creation objectives. Conduct AI maturity assessments and identify capability gaps across people, process, technology and governance. Define target operating models for AI adoption at enterprise scale. Support post-merger integration and value creation programmes through AI-enabled business transformation. Generative AI Agentic AI Advisory Identify, prioritise and evaluate AI, GenAI and Agentic AI use cases. Design AI-driven value realisation frameworks and business cases. Advise clients on Large Language Models (LLMs), AI platforms, intelligent automation, digital workers and emerging technologies. Support enterprise-wide GenAI adoption strategies and scaling approaches. Collaborate with technology teams to translate strategy into execution roadmaps. AI Governance, Risk Responsible AI Design and implement Responsible AI frameworks. Establish AI governance models, controls, policies and oversight mechanisms. Assess AI-related risks including data privacy, cybersecurity, model bias, explainability and regulatory compliance. Support clients in developing Trusted AI and AI assurance programmes. Advise executive stakeholders on emerging AI regulations and industry best practices. Private Equity Value Creation Support Partner with EY-Parthenon value creation teams to identify AI-enabled EBITDA improvement opportunities. Support commercial due diligence and technology diligence engagements from an AI perspective. Develop AI-led transformation opportunities for portfolio companies. Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, process automation and operational efficiency. Business Development Market Leadership Lead proposal development and client presentations. Support account growth and strategic pursuit initiatives. Build reusable AI strategy methodologies, assets and accelerators. Publish thought leadership, white papers and market insights. Represent EY-Parthenon at industry forums and client events. Leadership People Development Lead multidisciplinary teams of strategy consultants, data scientists, AI specialists and transformation professionals. Coach and mentor Managers, Senior Managers and Consultants. Drive capability development within the AI Strategy practice. Support recruitment, workforce planning and talent development initiatives. Foster an innovation-led and collaborative culture across global teams. Expected Scope of Responsibility Independently manage multiple large consulting engagements. Own senior client relationships and executive stakeholder interactions. Drive complex workstreams with minimal Partner oversight. Contribute to practice revenue growth. Build scalable AI consulting capabilities across EY GDS. Collaborate with global EY-Parthenon, Consulting, Technology, Data Analytics and EY.ai teams. Preferred Experience Essential 15+ years of consulting, strategy, technology, analytics or digital transformation experience. 5+ years leading enterprise-scale AI, analytics or transformation programmes. Demonstrated experience working with C-suite stakeholders. Strong understanding of strategic planning and business transformation. Experience leading global delivery and distributed teams. Preferred Experience in strategy consulting firms such as EY-Parthenon, EY Consulting, MBB, Big Four, Accenture Strategy, Kearney, Strategy or equivalent. Experience supporting Private Equity, Corporate Strategy or Value Creation engagements. Experience with Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models, AI governance, data strategy, advanced analytics, intelligent automation, digital workforce solutions and cloud-based AI platforms. Qualifications Education Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Business or a related discipline. Preferred Qualifications MBA from a reputed institution. Master s degree in AI, Data Science, Analytics, Technology Management or a related field. Professional certifications in AI, Cloud, Analytics or Agile methodologies. Key Competencies Capability Area - Expected Competencies Strategic Leadership - Enterprise strategy development; market assessment and competitive analysis; value creation planning; executive stakeholder management AI Emerging Technology - AI strategy; Generative AI; AI governance; digital transformation; data and analytics strategy; AI operating models Consulting Excellence - Structured problem-solving; engagement leadership; workshop facilitation; executive storytelling; financial and business case modelling Commercial Acumen - Revenue generation; proposal leadership; account management; practice building Success Measures Client Outcomes Successful delivery of AI Strategy engagements Client satisfaction and relationship growth Quantifiable business value realised for clients Commercial Performance Sales and pipeline contribution Proposal conversion rate Account expansion and revenue growth Practice Development AI strategy capability development Thought leadership contributions Development of reusable methodologies and offerings People Leadership Team engagement and retention Coaching and talent development Leadership effectiveness Ideal EY GDS Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines the strategic thinking of an EY-Parthenon consultant with the practical AI transformation experience of a technology leader. They will have a proven track record of shaping AI-enabled business strategies, driving executive alignment, building governance frameworks, developing AI-driven value creation opportunities and leading globally distributed consulting teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. EY | Building a better working world
